people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.
translations.bsb: No one takes this honor upon himself; he must be called by God, just as Aaron was.
translations.kjv: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
translations.asv: And no man taketh the honor unto himself, but when he is called of God, even as was Aaron.
